segments.en:
(I desire to offer my homage and my praise) to the offered
Haomas and Zaothras, and to those also which shall yet be offered,
which smite victoriously, and are foes of hatred, and following
in company (as they do) with the healing virtues of sanctity,
following also in company with those of Chisti (religious knowledge),
and with the remedies of Mazda, and with those of Zarathushtra
and the Zarathushtrotema, (2) and to the offered Haomas and Zaothras
which accompany those remedies which belong to the holy disciple
well versed in good devices, and accompanying those of the itinerant
also versed in good devices, and accompanying those likewise of
the good Mazdayasnian Faith, and those of the pious and beneficent
Prayer for blessings, and of the pious and good veracity, and
of the pious word against unbelief, (3) for information and explanation,
for preparation (?) and devotion, for the libation and complete
offering, for the complete recital of the liturgy memorized as
well; and to those Haomas which are pungent, bounteous, holy,
and offered with sanctity (and for a blessing), to those which
are yet to be offered with sanctity, and which are now being celebrated,
and which are likewise in the future to be celebrated, to those
which are being pressed with sanctity, and to those which are
yet to be pressed, (to these I desire to approach, and to express
my homage and my praise). 4. And I desire to express my homage
and my praise to the strength of the strong, and to the victorious
blow of the mighty, to the powerful Rectitude and Blessedness,
to Chisti and the Priority for the powerful Ascendancy, and to
these powerful Yazads which are the Bountiful Immortals, who rule
aright, and dispose of all aright, ever-living, ever-helpful,
who, male and female, dwell together with the Good Mind, (to these
I desire in my homage and my praises to approach); (5) (yea, I
desire to approach for homage and praises toward) our Universal
Weal and Immortality, to the body of the Kine, and to the Kine's
Soul. (And I desire to approach) the Fire of the spoken name,
and toward that farm-house which is sanctified and which has fields
and comfort, and mercy (for the poor); (6) as a praiser with praise
for the sacrifice, homage, which is this praise of Ahura Mazda,
of the Bountiful Immortals, and of the holy and lofty Lord, for
the sacrifice, and homage of the Lord that most attains his ends,
and which is this praise of that blessedness which has approached
us, and of that well-timed prayer for blessings offered in the
ritual, (7) which is likewise the praise of the Mathra Spenta
(the bounteous word of reason), and of the Mazdayasnian Religion,
and the Praises of the Yasnas, which is also that of all the lords
of the ritual, and of all the well-timed prayers for blessings,
for the sacrifice, homage, propitiation, and glorification of
the entire creation of the holy (and the clean). 1. This section should be read before Y. 32.
segments.zh:
(我欲獻上我的敬禮與讚美) 獻給已被獻上的
豪麻和扎奧特拉斯，以及亦將被獻上的那些，
哪些勝利地擊打，且是仇恨的敵人，並且隨後
與（他們所做的）聖潔的治癒德行同在，
亦隨同與奇斯塔（宗教知識）的那些同在，
並與阿胡拉‧馬茲達的療癒同在，並與查拉圖斯特拉的療癒同在
以及查拉圖斯特羅特瑪，（2）以及所獻上的豪麻和扎奧特拉斯
伴隨那些屬於聖徒的療法
熟悉良好裝置，並隨同那些流浪者的
亦熟悉良好裝置，並隨同那些亦然的
善良的瑪紮達亞斯尼亞信仰，以及虔誠和有益者的
祈福祈禱，以及虔誠和良好真實性，和
虔誠之言對抗不信，（3）作為資訊與解釋，
為準備（？）和奉獻，為祭酒和完整
供獻，為完整誦讀的禮儀被記作
良好；以及對於那些辛辣、豐盛、聖潔的豪麻，
並以聖潔（並為祝福）獻上，對於那些
尚未以聖潔獻上，且現在正被慶祝，
而且亦將在未來被慶祝的，對那些
正被以聖潔壓榨的，以及對那些正在
尚未被壓榨，（對這些我願意接近，並表達
我的敬意和我的讚美）。4. 我願意表達我的敬意
以及我的讚美給予強者的力量，以及對勝利者的
有力量者的一擊，對強大的正義與福祉，
給奇斯塔和權力升華的優先，以及
這些強大的亞撒德，是的不朽聖者，誰統治
正確地，和處置所有正確地，永生，永助，
誰，男女，同住於善思，（給這些
靠近）； (5) (是的，我
想要靠近為敬拜和讚美面對) 我們的普遍
福祉與不朽，給予牛的身體，以及牛的
靈魂。（我願意靠近）所說名字之火，
並且朝向那座被聖化並且擁有田野的農舍
以及安慰，以及憐憫（為窮人）；（6）作為讚美者以讚美
為祭祀，為敬拜，這是對阿胡拉‧馬茲達的讚美，
不朽聖者，以及聖高之主，為
祭祀，以及主所最能達成其目的的敬拜，
以及這是讚美那已臨近的福氣
我們，以及在…中所獻上的適時祈福祈禱
儀式，（7）同樣是對曼特拉·斯彭塔的讚美
(豐盛的理性之言)，以及瑣德亞斯尼宗教，
以及亞斯納的讚美，這也是所有諸神的
儀式的，以及所有適時祈求福祉的祈禱，
為了獻祭、致敬、安撫和讚美的
全部聖潔（以及清淨）的創造。1. 本節應在 Y. 32 前閱讀。
